message.content:
Fix three YAML issues in `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/churn-renewal-forecast/deploy/kubernetes/base/services/`. Make exactly these changes, nothing else:

## Fix 1: Add `protocol: TCP` to service.yaml

In `service.yaml`, the ports entry is missing `protocol: TCP`. Change:

```yaml
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 3000
      name: http
```

To:

```yaml
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 3000
      name: http
      protocol: TCP
```

## Fix 2: Add `timeoutSeconds: 5` to both probes in web-deployment.yaml

In `web-deployment.yaml`, add `timeoutSeconds: 5` to both the `livenessProbe` and `readinessProbe`:

```yaml
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health/live
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 15
            periodSeconds: 20
            timeoutSeconds: 5
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/health/ready
              port: 3000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 5
```

## Fix 3: Add `app.kubernetes.io/component: web` label to ingress.yaml

In `ingress.yaml`, the `metadata.labels` section currently only has `app.kubernetes.io/name`. Add the component label:

```yaml
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
    app.kubernetes.io/component: web
```

## After fixes

Run:
```bash
kustomize build deploy/kubernetes/base/services
```
Confirm it still succeeds.

Then commit:
```bash
git add deploy/kubernetes/base/services/
git commit -m "fix: add protocol TCP, probe timeouts, ingress component label"
```

Work from: `/Users/steve.briggs/projects/churn-renewal-forecast`

- Files changed
- Validation result
